notes.title: ROMBIE hits BETA!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31776673/5054a656d732f55ef10cd30f5cef4465e5cf8714.png[/img]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/745090/ROMBIE/

ROMBIE is on its way to a great release, thanks to all of my private testers! Virtual Reality integration is next. Some of the latest improvements, including many visual ones:
[list]
[*]Higher resolution textures
[*]Post-processing effects
[*]More unique terrain models
[*]Customized terrain shaders
[*]Revamped decoration system
[*]New ability special effects
[/list]
An updated trailer, showing more unique gameplay features & set of screenshots are also on the to-do list for release. When will ROMBIE be released? Still looking at a month or two from now -- I want VR features, and general gameplay, to be polished on day one.

Want to help test? Head over to Facebook to apply:

http://www.phr00t.com/

notes.title: ROMBIE Design Teaser
notes.content:
Want to know how ROMBIE, the spiritual successor to 5089, is shaping up? I'm revealing a few details here:

https://www.facebook.com/phr00ts.software/photos/a.567366503315933.1073741826.307134109339175/1533292750056632/?type=3&theater

For example, items will not be lost on death! Only broken & repairable. Read more with the link above & please "Like" the page to keep up to date on development!

- Phr00t

notes.title: IndieDB contest & Trading Cards coming soon!
notes.content:
Hey all,

IndieDB is running a "Game of the Year" contest and I'd appreciate a vote -- just a simple click, no sign-up required:

http://www.indiedb.com/games/3079

http://www.indiedb.com/games/3089

Also, finishing touches are being put on Trading Cards for 3079! Hope to have them out in the next week or two.

You may also notice a black "command window" when starting 3079 -- this was added to resolve problems with "Play Time" & stuttering by modifying how the game is launched. You can safely ignore & minimize the black window (if you close it, Steam will think you closed the game). You can read more about it here:

http://steamcommunity.com/app/259620/discussions/0/648813728519652802/

Thank you again for your support,
- Phr00t

notes.title: 3079 v2.20 Update: Multiplayer fixes & item loss info
notes.content:
Hey all!

After receiving a very [url=http://www.indiedb.com/games/3079/forum/thread/java-thread-leak-in-server]throughout bug report[/url] on popular multiplayer servers, I squashed a nasty bug that would break them over time. Using public servers should be more reliable now -- let me know if you have any more issues in the forums.

Also, I've added a message that will tell you what item was lost when you respawn after dying. Thank you for the simple but effective suggestion!

Also keep voting on 3089's Greenlight -- hopefully we can get this pushed through ASAP!

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=173802719

OK, back to work!
- Phr00t
